onboarding.slide1Title: Codes that stay on your device
onboarding.slide1Subtitle: Secrets live in the iOS Keychain — not in the cloud.
onboarding.slide2Subtitle: Scan a QR code from the service or enter the setup key manually.
onboarding.slide3Subtitle: Tap the card to copy the code. Haptics and a short confirmation tell you it’s on the clipboard.
onboarding.slide4Subtitle: Unlock QR scanning, biometrics, and higher limits — stay on free tier until then.

otpCard.copyHint: Tap the card to copy the current code to the clipboard

lock.title: App locked
lock.subtitleDevice: Confirm with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode.

lock.deviceAuthCardHint: Face ID, Touch ID, or device passcode

title: Authenticator
emptySubtitle: Add your first account to start generating OTP codes.
devPremiumHint: Treats the app as Premium: QR scan, no 5-code lock overlay, and premium gates from usePremium. Release builds ignore this.

paywall.title: Premium
paywall.subtitle: Unlock QR scanning, biometrics for app unlock, and more accounts. Manage your subscription in Apple ID settings.
paywall.noProducts: No plans are available at the moment.
paywall.legalHint: Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period.
paywall.restoreEmptyBody: We could not find an active subscription for this Apple ID.
paywall.pendingBody: Apple is processing this transaction. Premium may activate in a few minutes.

fieldSecretOptionalHint: Leave blank to keep your current secret key.
errorEntryNotFound: This account could not be found. It may have been removed.
addAccountSheetIntro: Pick how you want to add a two-factor account.
addAccountSheetQrDesc: Scan the setup QR from Google, GitHub, 1Password, etc.

backup.title: Encrypted backup
backup.description: Export your accounts to encrypted JSON or import them back using the same password.
backup.payloadHint: Copy this text to a safe place. Keep your password separately.

backup.exportDoneBody: Encrypted payload is ready to copy.
